prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 服务器安全基线核查记录 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "受检服务器唯一编号" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 138px
  col 2: header "系统账户口令强度" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 3: header "外部网络访问开放" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 4: header "日志留存天数达标" · longest unbreakable word 28px · one-line width 123px
  col 5: header "漏洞补丁更新状态" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 6: header "高危端口关闭数量" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 7: header "近三十天告警次数" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 8: header "应急联系人确认情况" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 138px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A zh-CN server security-baseline audit record: one row per server, one column per control or measure, used to verify compliance and compare servers.","reading":"Readers identify a server in column 1, then scan across its row for pass/fail and counts; auditors also scan down individual check columns to compare servers. Headers are long and can wrap, while row IDs and values are short and must remain stable.","groups":["col 1 — server identity / row header; it should stand apart from the checks","cols 2, 3, 5, 8 — binary compliance or confirmation checks (是/否); same visual role","cols 4, 6, 7 — quantitative measures (days, port count, alert count); short numeric values"],"keep_intact":["server IDs 01–06","是/否 status values","numeric values such as 180, 365, 30, and port/alert counts","numbers and identifiers must not break across lines"],"may_wrap":["Chinese header labels in every column, especially 受检服务器唯一编号 and 应急联系人确认情况","header text may wrap at character boundaries; no data cell needs wrapping"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [110, 85, 85, 85, 85, 85, 85, 99] · table 720×278px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [96, 100, 100, 81, 99, 81, 81, 81] · table 720×301px · row heights [83, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [130, 81, 81, 81, 81, 81, 81, 103] · table 720×301px · row heights [83, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 8/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}
